preconditions.description: The input is a list of strings.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(name, str) for name in names)
preconditions.description: Every element in the input list is a string.

postconditions.description: The output list has the same length as the input list.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(code, str) and len(code) == 4 and code.isupper() for code in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every code in the output is a 4-letter uppercase string.

postconditions.expression: all(generate_code(name) == return_value[i] for i, name in enumerate(names))
postconditions.description: Each output code corresponds to the input name at the same index, generated by applying the rules: replace hyphens with spaces, split into words, and take letters based on word count (1 word: first 4; 2 words: first 2 of each; 3 words: first 1 of first two and first 2 of third; 4 words: first 1 of each).
